load_inference_model: load a fairchem MLIP inference model from a checkpoint file with optional config overrides and EMA support
get_backbone_class_from_checkpoint: extract the backbone model class from a fairchem checkpoint's config using the registry
load_tasks: load and instantiate Task objects from a fairchem checkpoint file's tasks_config
update_configs: recursively update a fairchem model config dictionary with new config values preserving nested structure
tf32_context_manager: use a context manager to temporarily enable TF32 precision for CUDA matmul and cuDNN operations
